<p><strong>官方名称：</strong>Medicine (Clinical Work)</p>

<p><strong>授予学位 / 项目类型：</strong>State Exam Program</p>

<p><strong>目录适用期：</strong>Current official directory, checked 2026-09-12</p>

<p><strong>条目类型：</strong>first-degree programme</p>

<p><strong>申请路径：</strong>Clinical phase only; prior preclinical medical education/examination is required; not direct admission from secondary school.</p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>专业内容与身份：</strong>本目录记录TUM医学临床阶段；前临床阶段在LMU完成。TUM页面列12学期属于医学培养整体口径，不能理解为临床阶段单独12学期。</p>
